fields.name: typing
fields.description: Selects the path. If truthy, the server gives you the `typing` condition for 4,000 ms and ignores `afk`. If falsy or absent, the server reads `afk`.

list.name: Typing
list.when: `typing` is truthy. The server sets `s.typing` to `{ms: 4000}`. The call costs nothing when `s.typing` was absent or had less than 3,000 ms left.

responses.name: Typing
responses.summary: Your character (`u+cid+nc`: the server does not recalculate your stats) with the new `s.typing`.

list.name: AFK
list.when: The server sets or clears `player.afk` from `afk`.

fields.name: afk
fields.coerce: compared with `=== true` and `=== false`: other values (`1`, `"true"`) do nothing
fields.description: `true` sets `player.afk`. `false` clears it, but only if `player.afk` had a value before.

responses.name: AFK change
responses.summary: Your character (`u+cid+nc`: the server does not recalculate your stats) with the new `afk`.

rows.when: `player.afk` is `"bot"` or `"code"`. The server keeps that value.
`afk` did not change `player.afk` (the same value, not a boolean, or `false` when `player.afk` was never set).
